These statistics include all complaints and enquiries that were decided from 01 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
Some cases are received and decided in different business years. This means the number of complaints and enquiries received may not match the number of decisions made.
'Upheld decisions per 100,000 residents' only applies to County Councils, District Councils, London Boroughs, Metropolitan Councils and Unitary Authorities.
Population figures are based on Office for National Statistics population estimates for England: mid-2024.
No population data is included for Council of the Isles of Scilly due to its uniquely small population size.
We may receive and decide complaints about the actions of authorities that have since been abolished. These authorites are not included in the calculation of the average of similar authorities.
You can find comparisons with last year's data on the second and third tabs of this workbook.
